narr: Heavy rain in the Calwood burn areas caused flash flooding from Geer Canyon Drive to CO 36.
ev: Localized flash flooding reported from Geer Canyon to Left Hand Canyon to CO36.
Heavy rain produced localized flash flooding in the Black Hollow area. The flooding hampered ongoing recovery work in the area.
A culvert was washed out along Sheep Creek making road 44H impassable.
Flash flooding occurred near The Retreat. Streamside and Black Creek Roads were impassable due to the flash flooding.
